method: Try each interchange and evaluate the expression

steps: Frivolous (trivial, of little importance) is opposite in sense to Big (significant)
Deride (mock, ridicule) is opposite to Encourage
Taunt and Jeer are synonyms, Detest unrelated
Figure: two overlapping arrow-shaped outlines with left point P and right point Q joined by a horizontal line; crossing lines through P and Q meet at X (top) and Y (bottom)
Triangles: left triangle (left edge with P), PXQ, PYQ
Small triangle in top spike near X, small triangle in bottom spike near Y
Two triangles in right rectangle: above the diagonal to bottom-right corner, and Q-bottom-right-corner-bottom-edge
Position-wise G/A, R/C, I/E, M/G, A/I, C/M, E/R all differ
check_code:
w='GRIMACE'; s=''.join(sorted(w))
n=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(w,s))
opts={'A':0,'B':1,'C':2,'D':3}
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==n]
assert fit==['A']

steps: Meager and Scarce are antonyms, Venerable unrelated
BROTHER: B+2=D, R+2=T, O+1=P, T+2=V, H+2=J, E+1=F, R+2=T -> DTPVJFT
D x E: D is sister of E
E / F: E is wife of F
F + G: F is father of G, so E is mother of G
G - H: G is brother of H, so E is mother of H
D is sister of H's mother -> Mother's sister
check_code:
parent={}; sib={}; spouse={}; female=set()
female.add('D'); sib['D']='E'
female.add('E'); spouse['E']='F'
parent['G']=('F','E')
parent['H']=parent['G']
mother_of_H=parent['H'][1]
rel=None
if sib['D']==mother_of_H and 'D' in female: rel="Mother's sister"
opts={'A':"Father's sister",'B':"Mother's sister",'C':'Sister','D':"Mother's mother"}
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==rel]
assert fit==['B']

check_code:
e='315 × 15 − 93 + 16 ÷ 7'
t=e.translate(str.maketrans({'×':'/','÷':'*','+':'-','−':'+'}))
r=eval(t)
opts={'A':4,'B':8,'C':2,'D':12}
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==r]
assert fit==['C']

s=[(7,14,23),(4,11,20)]
f=lambda a,b,c: b==a+7 and c==b+9
assert all(f(*x) for x in s)
opts={'A':(7,15,22),'B':(5,12,21),'C':(9,12,22),'D':(15,30,20)}
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if f(*v)]
assert fit==['B']

sh=lambda c,n: chr((ord(c)-65+n)%26+65)
s=['KES','MIQ','PMN','TQJ','YUE']
for i in range(4):
    assert sh(s[i][0],i+2)==s[i+1][0] and sh(s[i][1],4)==s[i+1][1] and sh(s[i][2],-(i+2))==s[i+1][2]
ans=sh('Y',6)+sh('U',4)+sh('E',-6)
opts={'A':'EYY','B':'EXY','C':'EXZ','D':'FYX'}
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==ans]
assert fit==['A']
